howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Convert all content to grayscale
howto.text: PrivaTools converts every embedded image to grayscale, re-saved as JPEG. If any text or vector drawing is still in color after that, every page of the document is re-rendered as a 200 DPI grayscale image. Either way, everything ends up greyscale.

howto.name: Download the grayscale PDF
howto.text: The size change depends on the file: in tests, a PDF of black text and a photo shrank by about a third, while a text PDF with one red heading grew many times over once its pages became images.

faq.a: Only if all the text and drawings were already black or gray: then only the images change and the text layer is kept. If anything is in color, every page becomes an image and the text is no longer searchable; run OCR PDF afterwards to add a text layer back.
Cheaper printing on black-and-white printers, a predictable look on monochrome devices, and archival storage.

faq.q: How does this differ from black-and-white?
faq.a: Grayscale preserves shading (256 grey levels). True black-and-white (1-bit) is harsher but smaller — not currently offered as a separate option.
